questions.title: Can an AI know when not to answer after the world changes?
questions.next_question: Construct two populations with the same observable confidence scores but different answer correctness. State exactly what additional assumption would make a transfer guarantee possible.

questions.title: When do ten agreeing AIs provide more evidence than one?
questions.next_question: On at least 200 prespecified public or synthetic tasks, does a preregistered panel rule outperform the required cost-matched baselines on held-out tasks, with task-level paired uncertainty and no worsening of wrong-anchor susceptibility beyond the stated margin?

questions.title: Can an agent use untrusted evidence without gaining new permissions?
questions.next_question: Specify a paired synthetic test with identical grants and P but different U, recording unauthorized actions, forbidden content flows, and legitimate completion separately for recipient-only and content-sensitive monitors.

questions.title: What must be deleted when an AI memory is asked to forget?
questions.next_question: Give a graph where one conclusion has two independent derivations. Revoke one source, then introduce a stale cached summary. Specify which result remains valid and which cached representation must be invalidated.

questions.title: Can a public AI benchmark stay informative after everyone has seen it?
questions.next_question: Construct two black-box systems with identical answers on every submitted test but different training exposure. What additional access or assumption would allow a contamination claim to be distinguished from a performance claim?

questions.title: Does AI self-correction beat spending the same budget on a fresh answer?
questions.next_question: On at least 200 held-out tasks with deterministic scoring, can a prespecified paired comparison estimate revision versus cost-matched resampling, including transition counts, feedback access and uncertainty?

questions.title: Can memory survive a change of model?
questions.next_question: Can a revised protocol specify a frozen item set, complete gold evidence, both fixed-reader estimands and paired equivalence criteria, then distinguish store quality, retrieval and answer failures without assuming unique causal attribution?

questions.title: PMC-001: preserving disagreements and retractions
